candidate_targets.known_readiness: historically reported 16/17 pre-dispatch gates; human cold-usability gate remains material

candidate_targets.blocking_condition: Assemble one-digest freeze bundle and mechanically verify the wrapper/stable_result correction in that exact target before external assignment.

selection_rule: A steward decision must name exactly one target version and full artifact/bundle digest, record rationale and exclusions, and cannot be inferred from prose, chronology, local test strength, or packet readiness.
operator_rule: Publisher, Operator, and Adjudicator roles must be disjoint for qualifying independent reproduction.
